definition.name: 77-Day Finisher
definition.description: Finished the final day of the 77-day challenge.

definition.name: Deep Roots
definition.description: Reached day 33 with deeper habits forming.

definition.name: Extreme Fire
definition.description: Completed a workout marked extreme.

definition.name: Faithful Start
definition.description: Posted the first honest check-in and started the record.

definition.name: Fifty Faithful
definition.description: Reached day 50 with faithful momentum.

definition.name: Final Watch
definition.description: Reached day 70 and entered the final stretch.

definition.name: First Sweat
definition.description: Completed a workout marked easy and kept the body in the fight.

definition.name: 14-Day Full Streak
definition.description: Held a fourteen-day full-standard streak.

definition.name: 21-Day Full Streak
definition.description: Held a twenty-one-day full-standard streak.

definition.name: 28-Day Full Streak
definition.description: Held a twenty-eight-day full-standard streak.

definition.name: 35-Day Full Streak
definition.description: Held a thirty-five-day full-standard streak.

definition.name: 42-Day Full Streak
definition.description: Held a forty-two-day full-standard streak.

definition.name: 49-Day Full Streak
definition.description: Held a forty-nine-day full-standard streak.

definition.name: 56-Day Full Streak
definition.description: Held a fifty-six-day full-standard streak.

definition.name: 63-Day Full Streak
definition.description: Held a sixty-three-day full-standard streak.

definition.name: 70-Day Full Streak
definition.description: Held a seventy-day full-standard streak.

definition.name: Halfway Fire
definition.description: Crossed the halfway point of the 77-day challenge.

definition.name: Hard Path
definition.description: Completed a workout marked hard.

definition.name: Honest Standard
definition.description: Posted a partial day instead of hiding the work.

definition.name: Iron Standard
definition.description: Completed all seven daily actions in one day.

definition.name: Morning Watch
definition.description: Opened the app three days in a row.

definition.name: Seven-Day Start
definition.description: Reached the first seven days of the challenge.

definition.name: Seven Sealed
definition.description: Held a seven-day full-standard streak.

definition.name: Sixty Strong
definition.description: Reached day 60 and kept showing up.

definition.name: Steady Grind
definition.description: Completed a workout marked medium and held the line.

definition.name: Streak Flame
definition.description: Held a three-day full-standard streak.

definition.name: One-Third Dominion
definition.description: Crossed one-third of the 77-day challenge.

definition.name: Three-Week Wall
definition.description: Reached day 21 and pushed through the early wall.

definition.name: Two-Week Guard

definition.name: Watchman Week
